questions.question_text: Which of the following is teratogenic effect of carbamazepine?
questions.explanation: Carbamazepine is known to increase the risk of neural tube defects and several other congenital abnormalities.

questions.question_text: What is the rate of Ebstein anomaly with lithium-exposed neonates?
questions.explanation: The incidence of Ebstein anomaly is increased to 2.7% in the group of lithium-exposed babies.

questions.question_text: Which of the following antidepressants would be most appropriate for use in a depressed patient with a history of epilepsy who is currently on VPA?
questions.explanation: An SSRI like fluoxetine would be a reasonable first choice as it does not significantly increase the risk of seizures.

questions.question_text: You decide to switch a patient from phenelzine to tranylcypromine. Which of the following dosing strategies should you use?

options.text: Discontinue phenelzine, wait for 4 weeks, and then start tranylcypromine
Discontinue phenelzine, wait for 2 weeks, and then start tranylcypromine
Discontinue phenelzine and start tranylcypromine immediately

correct_answer.text: Discontinue phenelzine, wait for 2 weeks, and then start tranylcypromine

correct_answers.text: Discontinue phenelzine, wait for 2 weeks, and then start tranylcypromine

questions.explanation: Concurrent use of phenelzine and tranylcypromine may result in hypertensive crisis; hence, a 2-week wait after discontinuation is necessary.

questions.question_text: Which of the following antipsychotic medications, when given orally, causes the least QTc prolongation at therapeutic doses?
questions.explanation: Quetiapine is associated with the least QTc prolongation compared to other options.

questions.question_text: Which of the following antidepressant medications is most useful in the treatment refractory of anergic depressed patient?
questions.explanation: Tranylcypromine, a non-selective MAOI, is an activating agent and can be used in the management of anergic depressed patients.

questions.question_text: A 26-year-old postpartum woman presents with low mood for the past 6 weeks. What would be the most appropriate medication to start?
questions.explanation: Mirtazapine's appetite-stimulating properties coupled with its sedating effect make it advantageous for this patient.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is true regarding vilazodone?

options.text: The recommended dose of vilazodone is 80mg once daily
It is an FDA-approved treatment for GAD
It is a partial agonist at 5-HTA receptor
It is a dual serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI)
The drug's bioavailability is unchanged with coadministration of food

correct_answer.text: It is a partial agonist at 5-HTA receptor

correct_answers.text: It is a partial agonist at 5-HTA receptor

questions.explanation: Vilazodone is a new antidepressant that is an SSRI and also a partial agonist at the 5-HTA receptor.

questions.question_text: Which of the following TCAs has most anti-histaminergic activity?
questions.explanation: Doxepin is a TCA with significant anti-histaminergic activity.

questions.question_text: Which of the following pharmacologic agents used in treatment of insomnia has the shortest half-life?
questions.explanation: Zaleplon is a benzodiazepine receptor agonist with a very short half-life of 1 hour.

questions.question_text: Which of the following SSRIs is most likely to cause a discontinuation syndrome?
questions.explanation: Paroxetine has the highest likelihood of a discontinuation syndrome, and gradual taper is recommended.

questions.question_text: You are treating a 53-year-old man with chronic schizoaffective disorder. He returns to the office with pathologic crying. What is the most appropriate intervention?

options.text: Carefully review pharmacy refill records for possible medication noncompliance
Start workup for TIA or stroke

correct_answer.text: Carefully review pharmacy refill records for possible medication noncompliance

correct_answers.text: Carefully review pharmacy refill records for possible medication noncompliance

questions.explanation: These symptoms suggest antidepressant discontinuation syndrome, which is common with venlafaxine.

questions.question_text: Which of the following endocrine side effects is most commonly seen with lithium therapy?
questions.explanation: Lithium can cause subclinical or overt hypothyroidism in about 20% of patients.

questions.question_text: 27-year-old woman has mood swings and irritability at menstruation. Which medication could be used in her treatment?
questions.explanation: Paroxetine can be used for the treatment of PMDD and can be administered during the luteal phase.

questions.question_text: A 30-year-old woman experiences excessive sleep and irritability. Which medication will be most appropriate in her management?
questions.explanation: Lithium is a mood stabilizer suitable for bipolar disorder.

questions.question_text: Which medication caused prolonged and painful erection in a patient taking a new medication for insomnia and nightmares?
questions.explanation: Prazosin can cause priapism as a side effect.

questions.question_text: A 35-year-old man with bipolar depression is unresponsive. Which medication is most likely involved in his overdose?
questions.explanation: TCA toxicity can cause anticholinergic symptoms, seen in this patient.

questions.question_text: Which benzodiazepine has a high risk of withdrawal symptoms including life-threatening seizures?
questions.explanation: Abrupt discontinuation of alprazolam can produce severe withdrawal symptoms, including seizures.

questions.question_text: Which of the following mood stabilizers carry the risk of worsening psoriasis?
questions.explanation: Lithium can exacerbate psoriasis vulgaris.

questions.question_text: Which of the following atypical neuroleptic agents is associated with the least extrapyramidal side effects?
questions.explanation: Clozapine is known for having the least extrapyramidal side effects among antipsychotics.

questions.question_text: All of the following statements are true regarding SSRIs EXCEPT:

options.text: SSRIs have a flat dose-response curve
Higher doses are required to treat OCD
PMDD responds well to SSRI treatment during late luteal phase
It is safe to use a different SSRI on a patient with a history of allergy to one SSRI

questions.explanation: All statements regarding SSRIs provided are true.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements should be taken into consideration before stopping oral risperidone?

options.text: When dose adjustment is made, clinical effects are expected after 3 weeks
Maximal drug release occurs after 5 weeks
Oral therapy should be continued for 3 weeks after the onset of IM therapy
Risperidone microspheres start releasing significant amount of drug after 3 weeks

questions.explanation: All provided statements are facts about the dosing and release profile of risperidone.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is true regarding drug interactions with Olanzapine extended release injectable suspension?

options.text: Injections are only for IM use and should not be given intravenously
Carbamazepine increases the clearance of Olanzapine
VPA may result in decreased Olanzapine plasma concentrations

questions.explanation: All statements regarding drug interactions with Olanzapine extended release are correct.

questions.question_text: Administration of SJW can decrease contraceptive efficacy by which of the following mechanisms?

options.text: Inducing the glycoprotein transport across intestinal lumen

questions.explanation: SJW is known to induce the CYP3A4 isoenzyme, which increases estrogen metabolism.

questions.question_text: Which of the following conventional antipsychotics is designated as high potency?
questions.explanation: Pimozide is classified as a high-potency antipsychotic.

questions.question_text: Which statements are true regarding the treatment of eating disorder?

options.text: First-line treatment for binge eating disorder is uncertain
SSRIs are the first-line treatment for bulimia nervosa
No pharmacotherapy is proven to be efficacious for anorexia nervosa
Calorie and psychotherapy are proven to be efficacious for anorexia nervosa

questions.explanation: All statements provided are indeed true regarding the management of eating disorders.

questions.question_text: Which of the following medications is approved by FDA for the treatment of involuntary motor movements in Huntington disease?
questions.explanation: Tetrabenazine is FDA approved for the treatment of involuntary movements in Huntington disease.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is used in the management of neuroleptic-induced dystonia?
questions.explanation: Benztropine is an anticholinergic drug used to manage neuroleptic-induced dystonia.

questions.question_text: Which of the following psychotropic medications increases the metabolism of oral contraceptive pills resulting in decreased efficacy?
questions.explanation: All listed medications can lead to reduced efficacy of contraceptive pills due to pharmacokinetic interactions.

questions.question_text: Which of the following agents can be used in the treatment of premature ejaculation?
questions.explanation: SSRIs, like Fluoxetine, are known to delay ejaculation and can thus be used to manage premature ejaculation.

questions.question_text: Which of the following medications selectively inhibits MAO-A?
questions.explanation: Moclobemide is a selective and reversible MAO-A inhibitor.

questions.question_text: By measuring their plasma drug levels, which of the following psychotropic agents may be clinically useful for optimal efficacious dosing EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Serum levels of Lamotrigine are not typically measured for dosing adjustments.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is true regarding prolactin level during neuroleptic therapy?

options.text: Clozapine has the least effect on prolactin therapy
Typical antipsychotics are associated with persistently elevated prolactin level
Aripiprazole can be used to normalize neuroleptic-induced prolactin elevation
Risperidone increases the prolactin level the most among the atypical neuroleptics

questions.explanation: All statements provided regarding prolactin levels during neuroleptic therapy are true.

questions.question_text: A 46-year-old man is in remission for major depressive disorder and has a history of three episodes of depression. What is the most appropriate statement regarding his management?

options.text: A drug holiday of at least 3 months must be attempted before considering antidepressant discontinuation in this patient
Antidepressant therapy can be safely discontinued provided patient agrees to monthly maintenance ECTs
Lifelong antidepressant maintenance treatment is indicated for this patient
Antidepressant therapy can be safely discontinued after 6 months of remission?
Antidepressant therapy can be safely discontinued after 12 months of remission?

correct_answer.text: Lifelong antidepressant maintenance treatment is indicated for this patient

correct_answers.text: Lifelong antidepressant maintenance treatment is indicated for this patient

questions.explanation: Lifelong antidepressant maintenance treatment is indicated for patients with a history of multiple depressive episodes.

questions.question_text: Which of the following medications can be used for the treatment of GAD that is not sedating?
questions.explanation: Buspirone is a non-sedative treatment option for Generalized Anxiety Disorder.

questions.question_text: Mr. A overdosed on scopolamine. Which of the following can be used in treating scopolamine overdose?
questions.explanation: Physostigmine is an indirect-acting parasympathomimetic used in anticholinergic toxicity.

questions.question_text: Concurrent administration of all of the following medications may increase the concentration of Lamotrigine EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: VPA may increase the elimination half-life of Lamotrigine, leading to potential toxicity.

questions.question_text: A 43-year-old combat veteran is being treated for PTSD with prazosin. Which side effect would you expect as a result of DDI between vardenafil and prazosin?
questions.explanation: Concurrent use may potentiate hypotensive effects.

questions.question_text: All of the following are true regarding lithium EXCEPT:

options.text: Patients on lithium should reduce their sodium intake
Hemodialysis is indicated for lithium overdose presenting with neurotoxicity
Current recommendation is to measure lithium level after 6 months
History of good functioning between episodes predicts a positive response to lithium prophylaxis
Serum lithium level should be measured in the sample drawn after 12 hours of the last dose

correct_answer.text: Patients on lithium should reduce their sodium intake

correct_answers.text: Patients on lithium should reduce their sodium intake

questions.explanation: Patients on lithium are advised to continue their usual sodium intake as low intake raises lithium levels.

questions.question_text: A 39-year-old man stabilized on olanzapine reports hearing voices again. What is the most likely cause of his relapse?
questions.explanation: Smoking induces CYP1A2, lowering serum levels of olanzapine, leading to breakthrough symptoms.

questions.question_text: Which of the following atypical antipsychotics is associated with least weight gain according to the CATIE trial?
questions.explanation: The CATIE trial concluded that body weight decrease was observed with Ziprasidone.

questions.question_text: Concurrent administration of Triazolam and which of the following results in triazolam toxicity?
questions.explanation: All mentioned medications can lead to potential toxicity when administered with Triazolam.

questions.question_text: Phentolamine is the treatment of choice for which condition?

options.text: Hypertensive crisis associated with MAOI and tyramine ingestion

correct_answer.text: Hypertensive crisis associated with MAOI and tyramine ingestion

correct_answers.text: Hypertensive crisis associated with MAOI and tyramine ingestion

questions.explanation: Phentolamine is an α-adrenergic blocker used in hypertensive crises.

questions.question_text: Which side effects are associated with Thioridazine?
questions.explanation: Thioridazine is associated with multiple adverse effects including retinal pigmentation.

questions.question_text: Which non-psychiatric medication could have caused acute focal dystonia in a patient?
questions.explanation: Metoclopramide is known to cause acute dystonic reactions.

questions.question_text: Which antidepressant is the most appropriate choice in the management of depression after MI?
questions.explanation: SSRIs like Sertraline are safe in post-MI patients, while other antidepressants may have contraindications.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is recommended for the treatment of depression with psychotic features?

options.text: Combination of an antidepressant and psychotherapy
Combination of an antidepressant and a mood stabilizer
Combination of an antipsychotic and psychotherapy
Combination of an antidepressant and an antipsychotic

correct_answer.text: Combination of an antidepressant and an antipsychotic

correct_answers.text: Combination of an antidepressant and an antipsychotic

questions.explanation: Combining an antidepressant with an antipsychotic is recommended for treating depression with psychotic features.

questions.question_text: Which agent is the treatment of choice for psychosis in Parkinson disease?
questions.explanation: Quetiapine is effective for treating psychotic symptoms in Parkinson's disease with a favorable side effect profile.

questions.question_text: A patient with PTSD is taking clonidine, trazodone, and ziprasidone. If linezolid is prescribed, what should be watched for?

options.text: Muscle cramps, excessive salivation, and diaphoresis
Muscle rigidity, hyperthermia, and altered mental status

correct_answer.text: Muscle rigidity, hyperthermia, and altered mental status

correct_answers.text: Muscle rigidity, hyperthermia, and altered mental status

questions.explanation: The combination may lead to serotonin syndrome, with symptoms including muscle rigidity and altered mental status.

questions.question_text: Which of the following agents is contraindicated in the treatment of mixed overdose with tricyclics and benzodiazepine?
questions.explanation: Flumazenil is contraindicated due to the risk of seizures when mixed overdose is present.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements regarding Oxcarbazepine is true?

options.text: Hypernatremia is a concern with Oxcarbazepine therapy.
Oxcarbazepine offers significant advantage about enzyme induction and auto-induction when compared with carbamazepine.
Oxcarbazepine has a lower risk of hematologic events compared with carbamazepine.

questions.explanation: Oxcarbazepine is associated with hyponatremia and has a similar adverse effect profile to carbamazepine.

questions.question_text: Concurrent use of risperidone and the lipid-lowering agent simvastatin can lead to which clinical scenario?

options.text: Lower serum risperidone concentrations and necessitate an increase in dose of risperidone
Reduction in the cholesterol-lowering effectiveness of simvastatin

questions.explanation: Concurrent use can increase the bioavailability of simvastatin, raising the risk of myopathy.

questions.question_text: Which antidepressant is devoid of sexual side effects?
questions.explanation: Nefazodone is known for having a lower incidence of sexual side effects compared to other antidepressants.

questions.question_text: After educating a patient about the risk of Depakote-induced pancreatitis, on which issue should you emphasize?

options.text: Immediately reporting symptoms such as ankle swelling and shortness of breath
Abstinence from alcohol during the course of Depakote therapy
Avoiding foods with high fat content
Compliance with laboratory testing for serum amylase every 3 months

correct_answer.text: Abstinence from alcohol during the course of Depakote therapy

correct_answers.text: Abstinence from alcohol during the course of Depakote therapy

questions.explanation: Patients on Depakote are advised to abstain from alcohol due to the risk of hepatotoxicity and pancreatitis.

questions.question_text: All of the following antipsychotic agents have potential to increase prolactin levels EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Aripiprazole is a partial agonist at D2 receptors and does not typically elevate prolactin levels.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is not true of antipsychotic-induced weight gain?

options.text: Antipsychotic-induced weight gain is best managed by diet, exercise, and behavioral interventions
Antipsychotic-induced weight gain is solely correlated to the affinity of the antipsychotic drug for histamine receptors
Currently approved pharmacologic treatments for obesity lack clear evidence of efficacy and safety in managing antipsychotic-induced weight gain
A combination of antipsychotic-induced weight gain and insulin sensitivity contributes to the increased risk of diabetes in schizophrenia
Rapid weight gain within the few months of treatment

correct_answer.text: Antipsychotic-induced weight gain is solely correlated to the affinity of the antipsychotic drug for histamine receptors

correct_answers.text: Antipsychotic-induced weight gain is solely correlated to the affinity of the antipsychotic drug for histamine receptors

questions.explanation: Weight gain can result from multiple mechanisms, not just histamine receptor affinity.

questions.question_text: Which mood stabilizer can be safely used in the treatment of bipolar disorder in a patient with liver cirrhosis?
questions.explanation: Lithium can be used safely as it does not carry the same risks of hepatotoxicity associated with the other options.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements regarding low platelet counts and thrombocytopenia associated with VPA therapy are true EXCEPT:

options.text: VPA-induced low platelet counts can be managed by close monitoring and may resolve without interruption of VPA treatment
It is not uncommon to see a drop in platelet count without thrombocytopenia or adverse clinical events in psychiatric patients receiving VPA
The risk of VPA-induced thrombocytopenia is dose related
Elderly patients, women, and those with low baseline platelet counts appear to be at higher risk for VPA-induced thrombocytopenia
The mechanism of VPA-induced thrombocytopenia is believed to be an immune destruction of platelets by VPA

correct_answer.text: The mechanism of VPA-induced thrombocytopenia is believed to be an immune destruction of platelets by VPA

correct_answers.text: The mechanism of VPA-induced thrombocytopenia is believed to be an immune destruction of platelets by VPA

questions.explanation: Thrombocytopenia from VPA is typically gradual and suggests a bone marrow suppression effect rather than immune-mediated destruction.

questions.question_text: Topiramate is useful in all of the following clinical conditions EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Topiramate is not FDA approved for the management of bipolar disorder manic episodes.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is the most common side effect of SSRIs?
questions.explanation: Gastrointestinal adverse effects are the most common side effects reported with SSRIs.

questions.question_text: Which of the following SSRIs has dopaminergic activity?
questions.explanation: Sertraline exhibits dopaminergic activity along with serotonin reuptake inhibition.

questions.question_text: All of the following are FDA approved indications for Aripiprazole EXCEPT:

options.text: Adjunctive treatment in major depressive disorder (MDD)

questions.explanation: Aripiprazole is not approved for treating the depressed phase of bipolar disorder.

questions.question_text: Which of the following antipsychotics is approved as a monotherapy for bipolar depression?
questions.explanation: Quetiapine has been approved as a monotherapy for managing bipolar depression.

questions.question_text: In which of the following psychiatric conditions can the therapeutic lag with SSRIs be as long as 8 to 12 weeks?
questions.explanation: Therapeutic lag with SSRIs in PTSD can take longer than with MDD.

questions.question_text: Which of the following psychotropic medications is associated with sialorrhea?
questions.explanation: Clozapine is known to cause sialorrhea in about 31% of patients during treatment.

questions.question_text: Which of the following SSRIs has the most affinity to muscarinic receptors?
questions.explanation: Paroxetine is recognized for its anticholinergic properties due to its affinity for muscarinic receptors.

questions.question_text: Which class of drugs has been associated with the development of a frontal lobe type syndrome characterized by apathy, indifference, loss of initiative, and/or disinhibition?
questions.explanation: SSRIs have been associated with apathy syndrome in some patients.
